difficulty_reason: The property P(f) = 'f is a local complete intersection morphism' for morphisms of algebraic spaces is fpqc local on the base. The retained proof is complete both directions: descent follows from flat base change preserving lci (chapter lemma flat-base-change-lci); ascent is written out — refine the fpqc cover to schemes, choose etale scheme presentations U -> V x_Y X -> V -> W -> Y, transfer the goal to the scheme morphism U -> V via the fpqc-recognizing lemma, then for each cover member factor U x_Y Y_i -> V x_Y X_i -> V x_Y Y_i as etale-then-flat-base-change-of-lci, and conclude with the schemes-side descent theorem (More on Morphisms, lemma descending-property-lci) plus the facts that lci is syntomic-local on the source (our L16201 is the schemes statement of that ingredient) and etale implies syntomic. Retained author proof at lines 11321-11368.
